mintAuthority.summary: FIDD is issuer-operated by Fidelity Digital Assets. The Ethereum token is a UUPS proxy with three DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE EOAs, five MINTER_ROLE EOAs, and one separate UPGRADER_ROLE EOA. There is no ProxyAdmin or timelock.

controls.label: Fidelity issuer-operated mint authority
controls.evidence: Fidelity describes FIDD as issued and supported by Fidelity Digital Assets under a full-service model covering issuance, purchases, redemptions, and reserves. All on-chain MINTER_ROLE holders are EOAs operated by Fidelity.

controls.label: FIDD Ethereum token (AccessControl)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526837, the implementation remained 0x8ae9cb3d9095da33555494110f567e3d974c6753 and the proxy-admin and beacon slots were zero. getRoleMemberCount() still returned three DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and five MINTER_ROLE holders, with the same addresses previously enumerated; eth_getCode returned empty bytecode for all eight.

controls.label: FIDD UPGRADER_ROLE holder
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526837, getRoleMemberCount(UPGRADER_ROLE) returned 1 and getRoleMember(...,0) returned this address; eth_getCode returned empty bytecode. Verified MintableToken source restricts _authorizeUpgrade() to UPGRADER_ROLE, so this single EOA can replace mint logic immediately.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526837, FIDD remained a UUPS proxy with implementation 0x8ae9cb3d..., zero proxy-admin and beacon slots, three default-admin EOAs, five minter EOAs, and one distinct upgrader EOA. Verified source gates _authorizeUpgrade() with UPGRADER_ROLE rather than DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. Economic-control evidence reviewed 2026-07-15: PwC examines FIDD reserves monthly; the latest available report covers 2026-05-29 and reconciles reserve assets to token liabilities. The OCC active national trust-bank list matches Fidelity Digital Assets, N.A. (charter 25398), the exact issuer. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: issuer EOAs directly mint and upgrade without a timelock, while monthly PwC reconciliation and the OCC-chartered issuer remain verified.
